{{Youmay|the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connecting the [[Ione system/Legends|Ione]] and [[Isis system]]s|[[Isis (disambiguation)|other uses of the term '''Isis''']]}}
A '''hyperroute''' connected the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Ione/Legends|Ione]] and [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] was previously secret, during the [[Time/Legends|time]] that Isis served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
